conviction_note: The FY26 quarter is mostly priced: 9M OP was already 93% of plan, and IFIS consensus (OP 1,900) sits above the plan (1,807). What this release adds is the FY27 guide, which management said on 2026-07-15 is the mid-term-plan OP of 2.2bn (+13-15% on a likely FY26 actual, against +57% this year and below the 12-month-forward analyst EPS of 598.7). The opposing item is a likely dividend increase off a 7% payout, which management flagged. The findings sum to +0.5 while the scaled number is slightly negative. They disagree because the dividend and M&A items are small, unconfirmed positives, and the scaled read weights this name's last two full-year prints (-11.1% and -7.5% on the next session). Rule 1 of LESSONS pulled p_up to 47.
bar: FY2026/8 OP: company plan 1,807m (held all year, kabutan https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9252). FY2027 bar: the company's own mid-term plan of revenue 22.0bn and OP 2.2bn, restated on the Q3 call (https://finance.logmi.jp/articles/385324), against IFIS's 12-month-forward analyst EPS of 598.7 yen (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportTarget?bcode=9252). positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% at 2026-10-14 and unchanged (baseline; https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Kabutan shows 信用倍率 as '－' on 2026-10-15 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=9252), meaning no computable margin short. No options and no skew. The company's ¥200m market buyback (51,100 shares, about 15% of daily volume over Jul-Sep) ended on 2026-09-28, so that bid has gone. The run-up is +3.43% over 20 days and -1.97% over 5. priced_lean is -0.17.

findings.finding: The FY2027 guidance the release will carry is very likely the mid-term-plan figure of revenue 22.0bn and OP 2.2bn, which management restated on the 2026-07-15 call ('来期は22億円を計画'). That is only about +13-15% OP growth on a FY26 actual tracking ~1.9-1.95bn, after +57% this year. It also sits below the IFIS 12-month-forward analyst EPS of 598.7 yen (about 1.6bn NP against roughly 1.35-1.4bn consistent with a 2.2bn OP).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Full-year prints with a new guide, close to next close from Yahoo bars: 2024-10-18 (FY25 guided NP -12%) -11.12%; 2025-10-15 (FY26 guided NP +67% plus 実質増配) -7.46%. Both new-year guides were sold.
findings.why_not_priced: The plan number has been public since Nov 2025, so part of this is priced. The stock trades at about 8x plan-consistent FY27 EPS and about 7x the analyst figure. If the market held the analyst view, the gap to the plan would be the bar the guide must clear; if it held only the plan, the stock would trade nearer 10x like FY26. What is not public is whether the company guides at the plan or above it after beating FY26.
findings.independence: The analyst figure is independent of the company (IFIS, https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportTarget?bcode=9252), but it is one source and a 12-month-forward blend, not a stated FY27 number.

findings.finding: FY26 will land modestly above the company plan and close to consensus. 9M OP was 1,681m (93.0% of plan, against 87% and 75% at the same point in the two prior years). The plan implies Q4 OP of only 126m against 152m a year ago. August-quarter stock-type revenue in the monthly KPI was 1,949m, +10.4% y/y. Against this, management flagged Q4 lead-acquisition spending, and consensus OP of 1,900m needs a Q4 of about 219m.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The progress rate is public on kabutan and the consensus already sits above the plan. Only the Q4 margin is unknown, and it is seasonally thin.
findings.independence: kabutan finance table https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9252 (9M figures and the 3-year progress rate)

findings.finding: A dividend increase or other shareholder return with the results is plausible. On the 2026-07-15 call management said that, because operating profit was coming in well, it would consider returning more to shareholders ('株主の方々に還元できるよう検討'). The FY26 dividend forecast is 30 yen on EPS of about 415 (a payout near 7%). The last full-year print carried a 25% effective dividend increase, and the 2024-11-28 resumption of the dividend moved the stock +18.06%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2024-11-28 dividend resumed at 20 yen: +18.06% the next session. 2025-10-15 effective +25% dividend increase alongside the guide: -7.46%, because the guide or Q4 dominated.
findings.why_not_priced: The statement sits in a call transcript, not in wire copy. The yield is 0.7%, so a holder pricing a payout step-up would show a higher multiple than the ~10x FY26 PER. The size of any increase is not known.
findings.independence: Same transcript as the guidance finding; dividend history from https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportDps?bcode=9252

findings.finding: The ¥200m market buyback that supported the stock from July to September is complete: 51,100 shares by 2026-09-28, about 15% of average daily volume. The company said the shares are for share-exchange M&A, not cancellation, so no repeat bid is implied.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-07-15 buyback announcement was followed by five straight up days (+2.99% the next session). The stock was flat at 4,220-4,320 after the 9/29 completion notice.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, having been public for two weeks. It matters only as the absence of a price-insensitive buyer in a ¥29m-a-day stock on the reaction day.

findings.finding: An M&A announcement alongside the results is possible. Treasury shares were re-accumulated explicitly for share-exchange M&A, no deal was done in FY26 (a Q&A topic on the 07-15 call), and management said it will pursue M&A actively when chances arise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not observed in this window. Past M&A was folded into later prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Inference only; nothing on TDnet in the last 31 days points to a deal. Sized small.
findings.independence: The buyback resolution text gives the same purpose: https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120260928541472.pdf

outside_window.finding: The updated mid-term plan (事業計画及び成長可能性に関する説明資料) was published 2025-11-26 last year, so a re-based multi-year plan probably lands in late November, after the window.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none filed; FY26 lands ~5-8% above plan in OP, inside consensus. Returns: a dividend increase is plausible (management flagged returns); the buyback has ended. New-year guide: very likely the mid-term plan's OP of 2.2bn, against an analyst 12m-forward EPS that sits higher. Quarter vs own 進捗率: 9M OP at 93% against 87% and 75% in prior years, already public.
baseline_tension: There is no skew and no disclosed short, and the run-up is flat, so the baseline says little. The strongest positive the release could carry is a meaningful dividend step-up (the 2024 resumption moved +18%) or a guide above the mid-term plan; I looked for both and found only management's intent to consider returns. The negative rests on the public plan number and this name's habit of selling full-year guides.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the guidance negative rests partly on the public mid-term-plan figure, so it shrank from -1.0 to -0.7 and p_up moved from 45 to 47.
Rule 2 (check the sign): the strongest positives (a dividend step-up, an M&A deal, a guide above the plan) were already searched for and filed; sizes unchanged.
